purpose: Capture how Havenwild's native editor and Atlas Mapper work folds into Ember as a generic game-maker editor while Havenwild loads as a hosted game project/profile.
monorepoTarget: Ember owns the generic editor/tooling modules; Havenwild remains a game project/profile loaded by that editor.
doNotCollapsePrematurely: Do not break stable Havenwild main while the asset mapper workspace is experimental.
Do not publish mapped tiles into runtime until validation metadata exists.
Do not fork Forge GUI styling into multiple incompatible UI systems.
